move: site tiles pop into a grid, camera pushes into centre, pulls back
how: Nine 370x230 browser tiles (seeded dark/light, gradient hero art) sit in a 3-column grid inside a camera wrapper. The camera eases scale 0.9 -> 1.0, y 40 -> 0 with power3.out over the first 30% of the 4s while tiles from() scale 0.7, opacity 0, y 60 with 0.8s expo.out in a row-by-row grid stagger (0.07s); a caption fades up. Each tile's hero art drifts y -8 / rotate -3 with a 1.8s sine.inOut yoyo. At 40% the camera pushes to scale 1.7, y 40 with 1.3s expo.inOut, the other eight tiles dim to opacity 0.35 and the centre tile's page scrolls y -40 (power2.inOut). At 85% the camera snaps back to scale 0.9, y 40 with expo.in, all tiles fade (power2.in) and the caption fades, matching the empty first frame.
adapt: Replace the nine site names, headlines and colour pairs (or real screenshots) and the caption; change which tile the camera targets via the nth-child(5) selectors. Keep the 0.8s expo.out pops with 0.07s grid stagger and the 1.3s expo.inOut push.
port: mount(el, shot) builds .cam > .grid with nine tiles from shot.sites via a seeded rng; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with pops from 0.0125D, push at 0.4D, scroll at 0.55D and pull-back at 0.85D. The from() tweens should become fromTo with immediateRender:false; the nth-child selectors must be scoped to el; the 3x370px grid assumes a 1280-wide frame.
caveats: from() tweens on tiles and caption have default immediateRender
loop closes visually: the frame is empty at both ends and the camera returns to scale 0.9 / y 40
